vibe_rationale: Founder-led surf, art, film and sustainability festival since 2010, close to SURPLUS in format but on hiatus with no current programme or partners confirmed.
fit_notes: Direct surf-culture fit with an adult, active audience and a SurfAid women's cup tie-in that gives a natural health hook; past partners include MINI and Hydro Flask, so non-endemic brands have joined. It is on hiatus, so treat it as a 2027 watch item until the organiser confirms a return.
